9th November 2026
Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today. Fable 5.2 is currently ranked first on Artificial Analysis. Anthropic say it "solved two open problems in the physics of black holes", so clearly their internal benchmarks have become more ambitious!
I've added the new models to llm-anthropic
, so you can now run prompts through Fable 5.2 like this:
uv tool install llm
llm install llm-anthropic
llm keys set anthropic
# paste key here
llm -m claude-fable-5.2 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle"
I ran pelicans at all five reasoning levels - low
, medium
, high
, xhigh
, and max
. You can see them all here - here's the best result I got, from xhigh
:
max
failed to return an image at all, running out of tokens after spending 128,000 thinking about them. That's the same bug that I saw with Opus 5.5 - but it's new for the Fable series, both Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 returned max effort pelicans just fine.
It's priced at $8/million input and $40/million output, which is a 20% discount on the previous Fable 5.1 ($10/$50).
I also used Fable 5.2 to help identify the source of a mysterious beep.
